title: Review every existing Engram test after the sync lands: what it protects, behaviour or shape, cost, duplicates, and keep, simplify or remove
outcome: Review every existing Engram test after the sync lands: what it protects, behaviour or shape, cost, duplicates, and keep, simplify or remove
acceptance: Every Engram test file or group is listed with: what it protects; whether it checks observable behaviour or the text or shape of code; whether it is brittle or tied to implementation detail; its cost (runtime and timeout, and whether it is really a benchmark); and duplicates
Each entry has a proposal (keep, simplify or remove) with a one-line reason, and the list is prioritised
No new gate or blocker is introduced; the agreed removals and simplifications are filed as items for Sol or Opus authors
disposal_reason: Duplicate of Kimi::Consultant's Engram child w-6252b4eb3fea under epic w-297979e6fa09 (c15db92c #388), filed for the same Greg request (Asistant 43498a6e #1620). The scope, Greg's quote and the prerequisite on w-45fe538db32a carry over to it.
